answer: I understand you're smelling gas in the kitchen. Please do not turn on any lights or electrical appliances, and do not use a lighter or match. Turn the red gas shut-off lever under the kitchen sink a quarter turn so it is across the pipe. Open the windows and balcony door. Leave the apartment and call the security desk and the emergency maintenance line from outside. It will be safe to return when Rafiq or the security team says it is safe.

Piped gas supplies the hob. In winter the gas pressure can be low early in the morning and the flame may look weak. This is normal; use the induction plate instead. To light the hob, press and turn the knob, and hold it for a few seconds. **Always turn the hob off when you leave the kitchen.** The red gas shut-off lever is under the kitchen sink (section 12.3)."},{"source_id":"8.5","title":"Cooking Pakistani dishes without setting off the alarm","text":"House manual > 8. Kitchen and Cooking > 8.5 Cooking Pakistani dishes without setting off the alarm

Frying onions, tempering spices (tadka) and making parathas can create smoke that triggers the smoke detector. Before you start, switch on the exhaust fan and open a window, and use the lowest flame that works. **Never cover or disable the smoke detector.** If the alarm sounds from cooking smoke, fan the detector with a towel and open the balcony door; it stops by itself within a minute. If you see actual flames, use the kitchen fire extinguisher or a damp cloth over the pan, leave the apartment and follow section 12.2."}]
